Thanks Vivek — quick thoughts / proposed anchors below.

Proposed leveling anchors (short):
1) Scope of ownership: Senior = owns a feature/stack area end-to-end; Staff = drives cross-team platform capabilities and roadmap.
2) Complexity & scale: Senior = designs for 100s of QPS with clear ops plan; Staff = anticipates growth to 10x+ and designs migration paths.
3) Influence & mentoring: Senior = leads project execution; Staff = elevates other teams via patterns/PRs.

Interview focus suggestions (45'):
- Systems perf & optimization (measurable tradeoffs, profiling story) — anchor: latency-budget tradeoff
- Distributed KV/cache + batching design (production constraints, degraded modes) — anchor: failure isolation
- Cross-team collaboration + prioritization (how they navigated roadmap tradeoffs) — anchor: influence measures

Two evaluator questions I'd recommend for calibration:
A) "Walk me through a production incident where you traced a regression from a model input down to a kernel/infra change — what data did you instrument, what was the rollback plan, and how did you communicate impact?"
B) "Given a model that has unpredictable token-latency spikes, how would you prioritize short-term mitigations vs medium-term architectural fixes?"

I can take perf & batching. I'll add short scoring anchors to the eval-template: examples for a 1/2/3 (Below/Meets/Exceeds).

—Aditya
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

Agree with Aditya's anchors. A couple of additions from hiring / leveling perspective:
- Leveling signal: scope of ambiguity they can tolerate and still ship — look for moments where candidate set clear constraints and delivered incremental value.
- Evidence buckets: shipped product metrics, incident ownership, mentoring/peer reviews.

For the interview prompts: please include one quick debugging exercise (30') with real traces or logs (we can anonymize) — this is the best signal for operational maturity. Also:
- Make sure at least one interviewer pushes on prioritization tradeoffs (cost vs latency vs reliability).
- Avoid overly academic ML theory prompts; this role is infra-first.

I can cover the debugging/logging slot and will prepare a short 3-slide context packet and anonymized trace file (priyanka-desai-cv.pdf referenced).
